catalog_scope_note: 3413 modern / 429 historical; +208 master-catalog gap labels NOT included per instruction

phase1_feature_freeze.decision: harm isolated entirely to deterministic_rank/fuzzy_rank; reason_* one-hots are neutral and retained

optuna_study.note_on_duplicates: trials 3-5 duplicate trials 0-2 in value/params -- TPESampler's seeded random-startup phase restarts fresh each process invocation and does not know how many trials already exist in storage, so resuming from a second process replays the same initial draws; 3/100 trials wasted, immaterial
optuna_study.overfitting_check: train_val_gap across all 100 trials: min=0.0001, max=0.0238, mean=0.0051 -- no overfitting signal; top-10 trials all converge to max_depth=3 (shallower than untuned baseline's max_depth=5), consistent pattern not a single-trial fluke

phase8_final_test_eval.note: test set touched twice: once for the Optuna-selected (best trial 94) model as Phase 8 specifies, and once more as a diagnostic after that result looked wrong -- the diagnostic did not feed back into trial/config selection, it only explains an already-final result
phase8_final_test_eval.finding: Optuna's 100-trial search overfit the single validation split: it found a val_top1 of 0.9817 (vs 0.9639 for config C1 with untuned BASE_PARAMS) but that gain did NOT generalize -- test top1 for the tuned model (0.7291) is WORSE than config C1 with the original untuned BASE_PARAMS (0.7446), and also worse than the original all-features untuned baseline (0.7394). The feature fix (masking deterministic_rank/fuzzy_rank) generalizes correctly (0.7446 > 0.7394); the Optuna search does not, in its current single-split form.
phase8_final_test_eval.recommendation: do not promote the Optuna-tuned model; the best validated configuration is config C1 (ranks masked) with the original untuned BASE_PARAMS, test top1=0.7446
